title: Compare agreement and disagreement in optimization priority rows
description:
As an optimization operator, I want feedback volume and outcome agreement shown together on one common scale, so that I can compare portfolio priorities without mentally reconciling separate charts.

Out of scope: changing the ranking formula or feedback policy.

Feature: Comparable feedback composition in ranked priorities

Scenario: Show agreement and disagreement in one row
Given ranked priority rows contain valid feedback and reviewed disagreement counts
When the living Report renders the priority list
Then each row shows one horizontal feedback bar with agreements in green and disagreements in red
And the exact valid feedback, agreement, disagreement, and disagreement-rate values remain readable

Scenario: Use one portfolio-wide scale
Given ranked rows have different valid-feedback totals
When their feedback bars are rendered
Then every bar uses the largest visible valid-feedback total as the common maximum
And shorter bars visibly represent lower feedback volume

Scenario: Preserve accessible meaning
Given a user relies on text or assistive technology
When the feedback composition is rendered
Then the bar exposes a concise label containing agreement, disagreement, and total counts
And color is not the only way to distinguish the two segments

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the specified priority-row visualization. Each visible score now has one feedback-composition bar on a portfolio-wide valid-feedback scale; green shows agreements, red shows reviewed disagreements, and the same line retains exact agreement, disagreement, total, and rate values. Color is reinforced by labels and accessible meter text. Focused Jest: 2 passed. Full dashboard TypeScript checks passed. Verified against a live local Report: the largest feedback total renders at 100 percent, lower-volume rows scale down, and segment widths reconcile to the displayed rate. No ranking or feedback policy changed.
